title: Ubutumwa mu gisagara ca kera
intro: Igisagara ca kera cari gifise inkungugu, abantu baco bari bashinze imizi mu kwihakana, be n’imburi ya nyuma itagira ico ikora. Uyu musi, n’ushire intambwe mu ruhara rw’aboherejwe na Allah kugira ngo bashikirize ubutumwa abantu b’inkozi z’ikibi. Inkuru y’ukwangwa, ijwi ry’ukwizera rimwe gusa, n’iherezo ryashizweko ikidodo n’itegeko ritera ubwoba. Ni nde avuga biciye kuri ivyo bimenyetso?
clues: Twararungitswe na Allah mu gisagara abantu baco bari barahevye ukuri .
Babiri muri twebwe twaje imbere, hanyuma uwugira gatatu araza araza kugira ngo dukomeze ubutumwa bwacu .
Abanyagisagara baratwanka, bavuga ko ata kindi turi atari abantu nka bo .
Umuntu umwe gusa wo ku mpera y’igisagara ya kure cane yarirutse kubwira abantu ngo badukurikire .
Mu gutaka kumwe gusenyura kwavuye mw’ijuru, igisagara cacu cose caracerejwe .

identity.label: Jewe ndi nde?
options: Intumwa z'Igisagara ziri muri Sura Ya-Sin
Abapfumu bo mu rugo rwa Farawoni
identity.answer: Intumwa z'Igisagara ziri muri Sura Ya-Sin

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Yaturiwe ari muzima mu muriro munini ururumba .
Yamizwe n'ifi nini mu kiyaga kirekire .
Bahatiwe gukora cane mu kwubaka inkingi ndende

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Igisagara carasambutse n’induru imwe gusa y’agahomerabunwa (Sayha) .
Uwo munyagitugu n'ingabo ziwe bararohama mu kiyaga cacitsemwo ibice .
Imvura y'amabuye ivuye mw'ijuru irasambura ico gisagara .
outcome.answer: Igisagara carasambutse n’induru imwe gusa y’agahomerabunwa (Sayha) .

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
